title: A simplex-based measure of symmetry
summary: For compact convex sets $L,K \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, denote by $λ_K(L)$ the smallest size of a homothet of $K$ that contains $L$. We define a measure of symmetry based on the $n$-simplex $Δ= Δ^n \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ as the ratio \[ ρ_Δ(L):=\frac{λ_{-Δ}(L)}{λ_Δ(L)}. \] We study this measure and deduce the following results: (1) The classical Minkowski measure of symmetry $m^*(L)$ can be defined as an affine-invariant version of $ρ_Δ(L)$. (2) We improve the stability analysis for the Minkowski measure of symmetry; if $m^*(L)\ge n-\varepsilon$ then $L$ is $\tfrac{1}{1-\varepsilon}$-close to $Δ$…
